summary: CAE Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report) disclosing a consent and proxy solicitation to amend the indenture governing its $400 million 5.541% Series 1 Senior Unsecured Notes due June 12, 2028. The amendment redefines accounting principles to permit a potential IFRS-to-US GAAP transition, effective as early as the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 on a full retrospective basis. Noteholders of record November 9, 2026 vote one per $1,000 principal; a meeting is set for December 16, 2026 in Montreal if the written-consent threshold is unmet. Consenting holders receive a $1.00 per $1,000 consent fee. Watch whether the consent threshold is reached ahead of the meeting and any collateral effects on note trading.
